m2_coverage_rules.rule: >=80% of resolved members AND >=20 genes surviving per-fold zero-variance exclusion
m2_coverage_rules.missing_members: EXCLUDED from the score and enumerated; never substituted

if_proposed_in_future_require: reassess the scientific rationale and missingness
reconsider whether multiple imputation is justified
obtain explicit approval before changing the model specification
contingency.note: Multiple imputation must NOT be activated automatically.

pooling_rubin_vs_averaged_predictions.reason: Pooling across imputations has no role under a complete-case strategy. No pooling strategy is specified, and none is invented.
pooling_rubin_vs_averaged_predictions.reopens_if: multiple imputation is proposed AND approved in a future analysis

preserved_phase6d_findings.nd_na_distinction: The deposit documents 'ND: not determined' and 'NA: Not applicable', but ND is used 0 times. Both meanings collapse to 'N/A'.
preserved_phase6d_findings.structural_na: Structural N/A values (e.g. chemotherapy type when no chemotherapy was given; mutation detail columns when WT) must NOT be treated as ordinary missing observations.
preserved_phase6d_findings.batch_association: Molecular assay availability is strongly associated with processing batch: tp53.mutation missingness is 0% in four batches and 100% in three.
preserved_phase6d_findings.mechanism_qualified: MCAR is inconsistent with the evidence. MAR (conditional on batch) and MNAR/structural remain QUALIFIED ASSESSMENTS, not proven classifications.
preserved_phase6d_findings.single_missing_chemotherapy: One observation (GSM972262 / CIT306) has chemotherapy.adjuvant = 'N/A' and is the sole complete-case exclusion. It is documented, never silently discarded.

modification_policy: Immutable. A change of strategy requires a new approval, a recomputed complete-case assessment, and a re-freeze. Multiple imputation must never be activated automatically.
